positive_snippets:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Wonderful stay & great hospitality

We had an amazing time at this resort. The booking was affordable, and the overall experience was truly wonderful. The staff were extremely helpful and available at all times—even late at night—which made us feel very well taken care of.

The rooms were clean, the resort was green and spacious, and our group of 6 adults and 5 kids enjoyed it a lot, especially the kids. The Adventure Park activities were fun. The water park was closed due to winter, but the infrastructure looks very good.

A special thanks to a very helpful Bengali staff member. The owner Mr. Chaddha personally checked in for feedback, which we really appreciated. We were also given a complimentary JBL Bluetooth speaker, which was a great gesture.

Suggestion: Bathrooms should be rechecked once for better maintenance.

Overall, a great family-friendly resort and highly recommended!

We had a really pleasant stay at the Club Platinum resort. The service and food quality were excellent and truly deserve full marks. Special thanks to Mr. Azhar — he was very nice, supportive, and always willing to help, which made our experience even better.

Overall, it was a great stay. There is just a very small scope for improvement in cleanliness in a few areas, but it did not affect our overall experience. Would definitely recommend this place.
One of the best resort for party vibes, we had spend the times with kiddos. Seriously it is very nice place for kids and adults well. Staff well cooperative and food taste was also awesome.
